_comment: GOLDEN FIXTURE B — backtest Run 3 CORRECTED (docs/backtests/BACKTEST-2026-07-15.md). Single fabric, NO redundancy. Per maintainer rulings 2026-07-16 (B4/B6 increment): hosts are SINGLE-HOMED (1 of the 2 NIC ports used, the other spare) → 60 links, and a 2-leaf design has NO new spine tier — the leaves uplink DIRECT to the customer's existing core (border-leaf), matching the engine's >2-leaf rule and the backtest's stated preference. So: 2x S4348T-ON, 60x Cat6A, no S5232F spine, no leaf-to-spine AOC, mgmtcable 62, no ICL, no pair language. Diff semantics per Amendment 3: structured essentials only. Two deliberate exceptions: the no-ToR-pair phrase-absence check and the absence assertions (spine / leaf-to-spine uplink qty 0).
migrationNote: This is the spine-less / direct-to-core variant. When J2's uplinkTarget lands (INPUT-SCHEMA.md §1.4), this fixture keeps pinning the 'existing-core' value; a separate with-spine fixture (the 'new-spine' growth opt-in) is added then. coreHandoff:'our-side' (J3) is already the shape pinned here.
name: Fixture B — 60x R660/R760, 10GBase-T 2-port, 2 racks, single fabric no redundancy

expected.label: leaf switches — ONE per rack, single-homed hosts (not 4, not 8)
NO new spine — a 2-leaf design uplinks direct to the existing core (engine >2-leaf rule + backtest preference; growth-spine is J2's opt-in)
OOB switches — one per DECLARED rack (2, not 3)
host cabling — 60 links (single-homed: 1 of 2 NIC ports used, 2nd spare), 1 Cat6A each
NO pair interconnect — no pairs exist
NO leaf-to-spine uplinks — no spine tier exists; uplinks go direct to core
OOB cabling within-rack — 60 hosts + 2 leaf switch mgmt ports (no spine; OOB not self-cabled per ruling 2026-07-16) = 62
OOB inter-rack uplinks — 1 per rack x 2
inter-network transceivers — leaves direct to core, our side only (2)
inter-network patch cords — 2 per link x 2 links

phraseAbsence.label: no ToR-pair language anywhere — pairs are a redundancy construct (backtest Fixture B LANGUAGE rule)
